english.title: Operator of food business part possession of food hygiene rating sticker to unauthorised person - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a food business establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY ESTABLISHMENT..), without reasonable excuse parted with possession of a food hygiene rating sticker to **(..SPECIFY PERSON TO WHOM STICKER WAS GIVEN..), a person other than an authorised officer of a food authority
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 9(1)(d) and 20 of the Food Hygiene (Rating) Wales Act 2013.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the operator of a food business establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY ESTABLISHMENT..), without reasonable excuse parted with possession of a food hygiene rating sticker to **(..SPECIFY PERSON TO WHOM STICKER WAS GIVEN..), a person other than an authorised officer of a food authority.

other.penalty:

Fixed Penalty Ticket: two hundred pounds, reduced to one hundred and fifty pounds if paid within 14 days of issue of notice.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
